jobs.title: Applied Scientist – LLM & Applied AI
jobs.snippet: Amazon's Applied AI team in Sydney seeks Senior Applied Scientists to push the boundaries of ML and Generative AI, building LLM-based solutions across AWS services. Work alongside world-class scientists and engineers to deliver production-grade AI.
jobs.description:
## About Amazon

Amazon Science operates one of the world's largest applied AI research organisations, with a strong presence in Sydney spanning machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, and generative AI.

## About the Role

The Applied AI team is looking for Senior Applied Scientists who will drive innovation in large language models and generative AI applications across AWS and Amazon's products. You will push the boundaries of ML and Generative AI techniques, transforming research into scalable production systems.

## Responsibilities

- Design and develop novel LLM-based solutions across AWS services and Amazon product lines
- Lead research initiatives bridging fundamental ML science with production engineering
- Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver AI capabilities at scale
- Publish findings at top ML venues and contribute to Amazon's scientific community
- Mentor junior scientists and engineers

## Requirements

- PhD or equivalent research experience in Machine Learning, NLP, or a related field
- Strong publication record in generative AI, LLMs, or applied ML
- Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow)
- Experience productionising ML models in cloud environments (AWS preferred)
- 5+ years applied research or industry experience

## Tech Stack

Python · PyTorch · AWS SageMaker · LLMs · Generative AI · MLOps

## Benefits

- Competitive total compensation including equity
- Relocation assistance
- Access to world-class compute infrastructure
- Collaborative research environment with global Amazon Science teams
